sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球跨境基金设立第一大国、超大型跨国投资架构

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Vessel Hull and Cargo Damage Marine Claims Inspection Survey

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Romano-Germanic, French Code civil tradition, Belgian influence; unitary national system, no sub-state corporate law divergence)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: BLEU BIT Network (Belgium-Luxembourg Economic Union, 60+ bilateral investment treaties with third states)
EU-China Comprehensive Agreement on Investment (signed 2020, pending ratification)
Luxembourg-United States Income Tax Convention (DTA, 1996 as amended, in force 2000)
Luxembourg intra-EU tax treaty framework grounded in EU directives (Parent-Subsidiary Directive 2011/96/EU, Interest-Royalties Directive 2003/49/EC)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Loi modifiée du 12 novembre 2004 relative à la lutte contre le blanchiment et contre le financement du terrorisme (as amended, including by the Loi du 5 septembre 2023 transposing Directive (EU) 2018/843/AMLD5); Loi du 13 janvier 2019 instituant un Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (RBE Law, effective 1 March 2019, as amended); Règlement grand-ducal of 22 July 2019 on RBE implementation; Loi modifiée du 10 août 1915 concernant les sociétés commerciales (Company Law); CSSF Regulation No 12-02 on AML/CFT; applicable CSSF circulars, including CSSF Circular 18/698 on beneficial ownership.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copy of each UBO, shareholder and manager (gérant)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent passport authority of the country of origin, or local notary/consulate certification
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the issuing state is a party to the Hague Convention of 5 October 1961; otherwise Consular Legalization through the Luxembourg embassy/consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address of each UBO (utility bill or bank statement)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider / bank, with notarial certification in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation, register of directors/shareholders and good standing certificate of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official company registry of the jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization (plus certified French/German translation for RCS filing)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank attestation of paid-up capital (blocage de capital or attestation de libération) confirming at least EUR 3,000 (25% of SARL minimum capital) is credited on a Luxembourg bank account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Luxembourg credit institution licensed by the CSSF
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: No apostille required; original bank letter delivered to the Luxembourg notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO self-declaration and indirect ownership chain schedule (organizational chart) certifying the 25% threshold analysis
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Signature authenticated before Luxembourg notary or foreign notary with Hague Apostille

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, managers and UBOs against (i) the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, (ii) the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List (CFSP), (iii) FATF High-Risk Jurisdiction statements, and (iv) Luxembourg national freezing measures under the Law of 12 November 2004 as amended. PEP identification follows AMLD5 Article 3(9), requiring enhanced due diligence for at least 12 months after the PEP function ends. As a prudent market benchmark for USD-denominated payment rails (Underwriter_Wire and Wise), additional screening against the OFAC SDN List is applied. Continuous monitoring is required; any positive sanction/PEP hit must be escalated to the Cellule de Renseignement Financier (CRF) via a Suspicious Transaction Report under Article 5 of the 2004 AML Law, and the contemplated initial filing rejected or deferred.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) online portal (https://www.lbr.lu; https://www.lu.business-register.lu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must be written in Latin alphabet characters; names originally in non-Latin scripts (e.g., Cyrillic, Arabic, CJK) require verified transliteration into Latin script before RCS reservation. The articles of association and all RCS filings are drafted in French (market standard), with German and Luxembourgish also legally acceptable; English-language drafting is possible in notarial practice but French is recommended for registry compatibility. The name must be distinguishable from existing registered names and not contrary to public order or good morals. Transliteration accents and special characters ('umbau', 'OE') must be minimized to avoid registry duplication flags.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: PFS / PROFESSIONAL OF THE FINANCIAL SECTOR
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may within 8 working days request a written statement of reasons from the RCS registrar, then resubmit an amended name proposal (standard filing fee applies). Where the registrar maintains the refusal, the applicant may file a judicial appeal before the Tribunal d'arrondissement de Luxembourg (commercial chamber) under the Law of 19 December 2002 on the RCS, by service of a writ (assignation) within 15 days of notification of the refusal; the court may order registration, impose a new name variant, or award damages for arbitrary refusal. In parallel, the notary may file a second administrative request with the RCS for an identical or near-identical name if the first rejection was based on incorrect similarity matching. Extension of an accepted reservation is available for one additional 60-day period upon reasoned request and payment of the extension fee, provided no competing application has been made in the interim.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Domiciliation is lawful only through a licensed domiciliation agent under the Law of 31 May 1999 on the domiciliation of companies, as amended. However, a pure virtual office is not acceptable as the sole registered office for an active marine cargo claims inspection and surveying operation: the entity must maintain a physical place of business in Luxembourg, retain local operational equipment and survey records, and demonstrate that strategic management decisions for the surveying activity are taken in Luxembourg. For tax substance purposes, at least one locally resident director (gérant) or an alternative permanent establishment-consistent presence must be evidenced; otherwise the entity risks recharacterization of its Luxembourg seat for VAT and CIT purposes.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (approximately 10%) for routine RCS compliance verifications; moderate (approximately 30%) for economic substance, CIT and VAT desk audits if the registered office consists solely of a domiciliation address without local employees, contracts, or survey-related decision-making. For the activity scope in ISIC 5222 (vessel hull and cargo damage claims inspection), the CSSF does not require a financial-sector licence; however, if the entity engages in regulated insurance distribution or claims adjustment services binding on insurers, registration with the Commissariat aux Assurances (CAA) under the Law of 7 December 2015 may be triggered, increasing inspection probability.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal due diligence, UBO chain piercing, AML/KYC file assembly, PEP/UN/EU/OFAC sanctions database runs and ownership structure memo
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg law firm (avocat à la Cour)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark: EUR 250–EUR 450 per hour, blended 10–14 hours for low-risk marine surveying structure

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified French translations of foreign identity, corporate and proof-of-address documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator (traducteur assermenté) approved by Luxembourg courts
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate per translated page with affidavit of accuracy

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial deed of incorporation (acte constitutif) drafting, review and execution ceremony for the SARL
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg notary (Chambre des Notaires du Luxembourg)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff plus official ancillary charges; prevailing market range EUR 1,800–EUR 3,000

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RCS company name clearance request and availability reservation filing fee
RCS incorporation registration fee (inscription au registre de commerce et des sociétés)
RESA electronic official gazette publication fee (Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations)
Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE) initial UBO filing and certification of receipt
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (Ministry of Justice)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Free of charge by law under the RBE Law of 13 January 2019; only certified extracts later incur fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and/or consular legalization of the KYC document bundle (estimated 4–6 foreign documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent issuing authorities in each country of origin and Luxembourg Ministry of Justice (Service de la Législation) for apostille countersignature
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official per-document fees plus courier and translation verification costs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office domiciliation service (first quarter, prepaid)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Luxembourg domiciliation agent (Law of 31 May 1999)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market tariff of EUR 1,200–EUR 2,400 per annum, prorated quarterly

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank attestation of paid-up capital (attestation de blocage) and remote bank account opening assistance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg credit institution licensed by the CSSF
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank tariff for attestation plus professional assistance fee for remote corporate onboarding

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended (Loi du 10 août 1915 concernant les sociétés commerciales), Part VI governing the Société à Responsabilité Limitée (SARL), Articles 710-1 to 710-24, read together with the Law of 19 December 2002 on the Register of Commerce and Companies (RCS) and the electronic filing and publication regime of the Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), operated by the Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) through the Guichet Unique Électronique at lbr.lu and MyGuichet.lu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Acte constitutif (notarial deed of incorporation, executed before a Luxembourg notary; a written private deed is permissible for a single-member SARL), filed electronically with the RCS and published in the Recueil Électronique des Sociétés et Associations (RESA).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Statutory minimum share capital of EUR 12,000 (unless the simplified Sàrl-S regime with EUR 1 capital is adopted). The entire capital must be subscribed; each quota must be paid up to at least 25% of its nominal value in cash into a blocked escrow account (compte bloqué) at a Luxembourg credit institution prior to incorporation. Contributions in kind require a statutory auditor's report and must be fully transferred within five years. The escrowed funds are released only upon effective RCS registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FOR THE FIRST BOARD SESSION OF THE FOUNDING SUBSCRIBER AND SOLE MANAGER: RESOLVED, UNANIMOUSLY, AS FOLLOWS: (1) SHARE SUBSCRIPTION: the founding shareholder hereby subscribes the entire share capital of EUR 12,000; each quota is acknowledged as paid up to the statutorily required portion, deposited into a blocked escrow account at a Luxembourg credit institution. (2) REGISTERED OFFICE: the registered office (siège social) is fixed at the address specified in the Articles of Association within the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg. (3) APPOINTMENT: [Name] is appointed Manager (Gérant), exercising sole signature authority. (4) AUTHORISATION: the Manager is directed to complete the RCS registration, RESA publication, establishment licence, VAT, and social security formalities and to open operating bank accounts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Legal Form Pre-Validation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR), electronic single window at lbr.lu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create a registered user account on the LBR portal, submit up to three proposed corporate denominations in order of preference together with the intended legal form (SARL) and the company's principal activity code, and obtain an official name reservation confirmation before drafting the Articles of Association.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name(s) in order of preference
Declaration of intended legal form (SARL) and registered office address
Identification document and contact data of the applicant or authorised representative
Optional trademark search certificate if the name includes a registered mark
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as conflicting, misleading, or contrary to public policy, the LBR portal issues a refusal notice; the applicant may immediately re-file up to three alternative denominations. A formal refusal may be appealed before the President of the District Court of Luxembourg within forty days of notification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Blocked Escrow Account and Deposit of Paid-Up Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Duly licensed Luxembourg credit institution supervised by the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a blocked account (compte bloqué) in the name of the company in formation and deposit at least 25% of the nominal value of each subscribed quota in cash. Obtain a bank attestation confirming the balance, the blocking of funds, and the account holder details; the attestation must remain valid until RCS registration for subsequent release of funds.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Association (project of acte constitutif)
Valid passport or national ID of the founding shareholder
Proof of residential address of the founding shareholder
Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) identification and ownership details
Source of funds declaration and banking references
Executed power of attorney if a representative acts for the shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises a query regarding beneficial ownership or source of funds, submit a supplemental source-of-wealth file. If the institution declines the account within ten business days, apply to another CSSF-regulated credit institution; the bank's blocked-account certificate may be extended in writing to cover the full incorporation timeline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Notarial Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary enrolled with the Chambre des Notaires du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appear before the chosen Luxembourg notary for the execution of the Acte constitutif containing the finalised Articles of Association. The notary verifies the legality of the corporate object, the paid-up capital evidence, the appointment of the first manager(s), the registered office address, and the identity and legal capacity of all subscribers before authenticating the deed.
required_dossiers: Finalised and pre-cleared Articles of Association (statuts)
Bank certificate of blocked capital deposit (attestation de consignation)
Address certificate or lease agreement for the registered office
Valid identity documents and tax identification numbers of all subscribers
Statement of no criminal convictions for the appointed manager(s), being a Luxembourg bulletin n°2 or equivalent foreign certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary detects a defect in the Articles of Association, such as an unlawful corporate object or insufficient paid-up capital, the draft is amended and re-signed; any notarial refusal may be avoided by submitting the draft Articles to the notary for pre-approval at least three working days before the signing date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS Electronic Registration and RESA Publication
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) via the Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the authenticated notarial deed and supporting documents electronically through the LBR single window, pay the EUR 75 registration duty, and request entry in the Trade and Companies Register. Upon registration, the RCS allocates a company registration number and publishes the deed and statutory particulars in the Recueil Électronique des Sociétés et Associations (RESA).
required_dossiers: Authentic notarial deed of incorporation (electronic transmission from the notary)
Confirmation of reserved company name
Proof of registered office address in Luxembourg
Identity documents and specimen signatures of the appointed manager(s)
Appointment and powers of the first board in the form required by the LBR portal
Bank certificate of capital deposit
Payment receipt for the EUR 75 registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS issues a query or rectification observation concerning the filing, the notary or authorised counsel must correct the dossier through the LBR portal within five working days. A final refusal of registration may be appealed to the District Court of Luxembourg (tribunal d'arrondissement) in accordance with the Law of 19 December 2002.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establishment Licence and Sectoral Professional Qualification Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of the Economy, General Directorate for SMEs (Direction générale des classes moyennes), submitted via MyGuichet.lu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the application for the autorisation d'établissement as a regulated intellectual professional activity of marine claims surveying. Demonstrate the applicant's professional integrity through a clean criminal record and prove professional competence by submitting recognised diplomas, professional experience, or an equivalency certificate covering marine insurance survey and vessel/cargo damage assessment, together with proof of the Luxembourg establishment premises.
required_dossiers: Application form for autorisation d'établissement submitted via MyGuichet.lu
Criminal record certificate (bulletin n°3) of the applicant and of the managing director
Evidence of professional qualification in marine surveying and insurance claims inspection
Proof of clean tax standing from the Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT)
Lease agreement or ownership title for the Luxembourg professional premises
Professional indemnity and marine surveyor liability insurance certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Ministry of the Economy requests supplementary proof of professional competence, the applicant has one month to complete the dossier. A formal refusal of the establishment licence may be contested before the Administrative Tribunal of Luxembourg within three months of notification, and interim suspension may be requested to avoid interruption of the company's start-up timeline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: VAT, Social Security, and Municipal Post-Registration Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT); Centre Commun de la Sécurité Sociale (CCSS); and the commune of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the duly incorporated SARL with the AEDT for VAT purposes and obtain the Luxembourg VAT number before commencing taxable operations; file the employer registration with the CCSS within eight days of the first recruitment; and complete the municipal business declaration as required by the commune of the registered office.
required_dossiers: RCS registration certificate and extract from the Trade and Companies Register
Notarial deed of incorporation and published RESA extract
Identity documents and appointment details of the manager(s)
Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) register filing confirmation
Operating bank account details
Employer declaration forms for the CCSS upon first hiring
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AEDT or CCSS rejects the application because of missing RCS extracts, re-submit once the RCS certificate is issued. Late filing may result in administrative fines; prompt corrective filing, supported by a letter explaining the timing, is generally accepted without further sanction when the company demonstrates good faith.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of the Economy, General Directorate for SMEs (Direction générale des classes moyennes), acting through the one-stop-shop for the establishment licence on MyGuichet.lu, in coordination with the Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM) for workplace compliance.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'établissement (Establishment Licence) for the regulated intellectual professional activity of marine insurance claims surveying, vessel hull and cargo damage inspection, issued under the Law of 2 September 2011 regulating access to the professions of craftsman, trader, industrialist and certain liberal professions.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'Environnement (Environment Agency) within the Ministry of the Environment, Climate and Biodiversity
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Full EIA Report not required under the Law of 15 May 2018 on environmental impact assessment, as the activity is office-based professional surveying without industrial installations; however, any new office fit-out remains subject to the municipal construction permit and, where a survey equipment or sampling warehouse is established, a declaratory environmental registration applies.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial point-source discharges are anticipated. Office wastewater must comply with the municipal sewer by-laws and the Law of 19 December 2008 on water management. If solvent-based cleaning of surveying equipment occurs, VOC emissions must remain below the Directive 1999/13/EC trigger threshold of 0.5 tonnes per year, with a mass-balance register maintained. Hazardous waste, such as petroleum-contaminated rags, fuel-sample residues, or batteries, must be transferred exclusively to certified waste operators and accompanied by transfer slips (bordereaux de suivi de déchets) under the Law of 21 March 2017 on waste prevention and management.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification of the professional premises is required from the communal fire brigade or the Corps grand-ducal d'incendie et de secours (CGDIS), including an approved safety dossier and functioning fire detection and extinguishing systems; the building must possess a structural conformity certificate or valid occupancy permit under the municipal building regulations. The workplace must be declared to the ITM under the Law of 17 June 1994 on occupational safety and health, and a workplace risk assessment must be prepared and submitted to the accredited occupational health service (service de santé au travail) prior to hiring the first employee.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des Contributions Directes (ACD) for direct taxes; Administration de l'Enregistrement, des Domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for VAT, registration duties, and excise. Primary e-portals: MyGuichet.lu, ACD eCDF professional filing portal, and AEDT eTVA portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Notarize the articles of association, deposit the minimum capital, and file the incorporation dossier with the Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) to obtain the RCS registration number. Step 2: Upon RCS registration, the ACD automatically assigns the national 13-digit business registration number (matricule), formally communicated by the competent bureau d'imposition. Step 3: Deliver Form 1 TVA (VAT registration application) to the AEDT together with the RCS extract, certified identity documents of managers, registered office proof, and a statement of intended activity; obtain the LU VAT identification number (LU plus 8 digits) normally within 5 to 10 working days before commencing any taxable activity. Step 4: Remain registered with the ACD for corporate income tax, municipal business tax, and net wealth tax; no separate direct tax certificate is required beyond the matricule.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; a resident SARL (société à responsabilité limitée) is a full taxpayer under Article 159 LIR, subject to corporate income tax on worldwide profits, with no fiscal transparency or pass-through allocation to shareholders. Combined Luxembourg City burden for 2025: corporate income tax 17%, solidarity surcharge 7% of CIT, municipal business tax 6.75%, aggregating to approximately 24.94%, before the 75% municipal business tax deductibility adjustment.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Luxembourg has no US-style check-the-box election; entity classification is determined by commercial law. Specific elections available: (1) fiscal unity (intégration fiscale) under Article 164bis LIR, requiring direct or indirect participation of at least 95% in taxable Luxembourg subsidiaries for private equity and industrial groups; (2) VAT grouping election under Article 60 VAT Law; (3) IP Box election under Article 50bis LIR granting an 80% exemption on qualifying intellectual property income subject to nexus substance requirements; (4) optional deemed dividend distribution and tax consolidation elections are not available to SARLs; hybrid mismatch outcomes are statutorily neutralized under ATAD I and II, and no elective opt-out exists.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: TVA - Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (Luxembourg Value Added Tax), implementing EU Directive 2006/112/EC
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No registration threshold for non-established foreign businesses: any non-resident entity making taxable supplies of goods or services in Luxembourg, or receiving intra-EU acquisitions exceeding EUR 10,000 per annum, has an immediate VAT registration obligation with no minimum turnover threshold. The domestic EUR 35,000 small-business exemption is unavailable to foreign entities and to a marine surveying SARL.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory B2B electronic invoicing introduced by the law of 13 June 2024, phased from 1 January 2026 for taxpayers issuing domestic B2B invoices above EUR 100,000 per year, and from 1 January 2027 for all taxpayers. Invoices must be issued via PEPPOL-compliant EN 16931 structured formats. Structured electronic reporting (e-reporting) of transactional VAT data to the AEDT becomes mandatory from 1 January 2027. No real-time continuous transaction controls (CTCs) or digital fiscal stamping regime is currently in force, and export invoices remain outside the domestic e-invoicing scope.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating under Article 55(1) of the Luxembourg VAT Law applies to goods physically dispatched or transported out of the EU and to services directly connected with the export chain, including vessel hull and cargo damage marine inspection and surveying services, provided: (i) the underlying goods are declared for export and leave the EU within a reasonable period (AEDT circular reference of 90 days), (ii) the surveyor holds documentary evidence identifying the export declaration, the goods, and the exporter, and (iii) the service is contractually linked to that specific export transaction. For cross-border B2B services where the customer is identified with a valid EU VAT identification number, zero-rating is achieved through the reverse charge mechanism under Articles 58 to 60 of the VAT Law, without requiring customs proof.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Formal customs export declaration (SAD/DAU) accepted and cleared by the EU customs office of exit
Commercial invoice and sales contract incorporating Incoterms
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or CMR/rail consignment note evidencing physical departure of goods from the EU
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT credit advice evidencing the receipt of export proceeds
Surveyor's cargo damage inspection report, weather and seaworthiness log, and vessel hull assessment certificate
Marine insurance open cover or single-voyage policy endorsing the surveyor engagement
Exporter's signed declaration confirming the goods have left EU customs territory and the VAT number of the exporter where applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The AEDT requires contemporaneous retention of all export substantiation for at least 10 years under Article 55(4) of the VAT Law and AEDT administrative circulars. Failure to produce credible evidence triggers rectification under Article 34 AO, reassessment of VAT at 17% on the contract price, monthly late-payment interest of 0.6% under Article 61 AO, and administrative fines up to EUR 250,000 under Articles 61 to 63 AO. Fraudulent zero-rating claims with intent to evade are prosecuted under Article 137 AO, carrying imprisonment of 8 days to 5 years and fines up to EUR 1,000,000. Luxembourg imposes no statutory foreign-exchange repatriation deadline; the 180-day benchmark serves as an internal export documentation standard, and abnormal delays in receiving export consideration may be recharacterized under Article 164bis LIR as an interest-free loan or deemed dividend, attracting thin capitalization review and net wealth tax consequences.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL), acting with the Luxembourg Ministry of Finance and the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) for bank licensing, AML/CFT supervision, and foreign exchange and balance-of-payments compliance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Luxembourg does not operate a foreign exchange control regime. The euro is fully convertible for both current and capital account transactions, and capital movements, payments, dividends, and profit repatriations are free under Article 63 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union. Cross-border transfers in EUR or other convertible currencies may be executed without exchange-control approval. Profit remittances from a Luxembourg SARL are subject only to corporate taxation and dividend withholding tax under Luxembourg domestic law and applicable tax treaties; there are no foreign-exchange conversion or prior-authorization hurdles.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Luxembourg imposes no statutory export-proceeds surrender requirement, no compulsory foreign-conversion ratio, and no deadline for repatriation of export receipts. A marine insurance surveyor invoicing non-resident underwriters or shipowners may retain export revenue in a foreign-currency account at a Luxembourg bank. The only residual obligations are the AML/KYC documentation duties imposed on credit institutions and BCL statistical balance-of-payments reporting for cross-border flows above applicable reporting thresholds.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Luxembourg-licensed or EU/EEA-passported electronic money institutions may provide transaction accounts and payment services to a Luxembourg SARL, but their legal use is limited to operational expense payments. Feasibility rating: Medium for ancillary treasury flows and low-value claims disbursements; Low for holding underwriter premiums or acting as a client-money escrow. Offshore digital EMIs without an EU passport are not permitted to provide payment services in Luxembourg. Marine claims inspection by its nature involves regulated insurance-sector payments, so funds received from underwriters should be held at a fully regulated credit institution rather than an EMI to preserve segregated-client-money protection and CSSF comfort.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Luxembourg banks generally require the ultimate beneficial owner and at least one authorized director, especially non-resident board members, to complete an initial identity interview. Depending on the bank's digital-KYC policy, this may be performed through an approved video-identification process using eIDAS qualified electronic signatures, but many established commercial banks require one physical appearance at a Luxembourg or EU branch for the opening of a corporate account. Notarized or apostilled corporate documents, certified translations, valid passports, proof of registered address, and evidence of the commercial substance of the marine-survey business must be submitted. Remote-only onboarding without any personal appearance is generally not available for non-resident-controlled SARLs.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex or opaque UBO chain, including trusts, foundations, or intermediate non-EU holding companies.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full shareholders' register, notarized corporate chart and UBO declarations, group organizational chart with LEI numbers, passport copies of all ultimate owners, apostilled certificates of good standing, and written explanations of each intermediate entity's economic substance and source of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital subscription from a jurisdiction outside the EU or from a jurisdiction considered high-risk by FATF and Luxembourg AML regulations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-wealth report, audited financial statements of the shareholder, bank reference letters, notarized board resolution approving the capital increase, underlying commercial agreement explaining the Luxembourg investment rationale, complete SWIFT transaction trail, and no-link-to-sanctioned-persons confirmation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived mismatch between the marine-surveyor commercial profile and expected international payment volumes or foreign-currency settlement patterns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enforced marine survey contracts, panel-appointment letters from underwriters, specimen claims reports, invoices and fee schedules, loss-adjustment mandates, projected annual volumes, client onboarding records, and the entity's CSSF/insurance-sector licensing evidence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of non-regulated payment providers or anticipated payments from high-risk shipping clients.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A written AML/KYC policy, an internal counterparty risk assessment, sanctions and adverse-media screening logs, confirmations that all marine claims funds will pass only through licensed credit institutions, and evidence of professional indemnity insurance covering marine surveying activity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For a Luxembourg SARL, an inbound capital injection from non-resident shareholders is executed by a standard SWIFT MT103 credit to a blocked capital-escrow account opened in the company's name with a Luxembourg credit institution. The wire reference must clearly state the counterparty, the legal entity name, and the commercial purpose, for example 'CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION — LU_SARL' or an equivalent ISO 20022 remittance structure. The bank issues a funds-confirmation certificate to the Luxembourg notary before the execution of the notarial deed of incorporation or capital increase. The institution records the transfer for AML/CFT purposes, and the BCL may collect the transaction through its balance-of-payments statistical framework. No exchange-control authorization or administrative permit is required for euro-denominated or convertible foreign-currency capital inflows.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound payments from the marine-survey SARL are cleared primarily through SEPA Credit Transfers for EUR-denominated payments within the European Economic Area and through SWIFT MT103 messages for non-EUR or third-country settlements. For claim settlements collected from underwriters and disbursed to surveyors, attorneys, marine casualty experts, or equipment suppliers, the SARL should use its corporate account with an IBAN and clearly structured remittance fields showing the underlying claims file number, insured vessel, and policy reference. A commercial letter of credit may be used where an overseas supplier insists on bank payment undertaking for physical survey equipment; however, standard maritime inspection-services disbursements do not require documentary letters of credit. All disbursements are subject to bank transaction monitoring and to the CSSF AML/CFT framework if the SARL is deemed to be operating an insurance-claims service.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla deliverable FX forward contracts with a licensed credit institution
Non-deliverable FX forwards (NDFs) for currencies not freely deliverable to the Luxembourg bank account
FX swaps for short-term conversion between EUR and major claim currencies such as USD, GBP, and CHF
Cross-currency interest rate swaps, permissible where the SARL has a committed multi-currency credit or claim-funding facility
Standard vanilla EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, and EUR/CHF options, limited to hedging of demonstrable underlying marine-claim receipts and disbursements

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts (including auditor's report where required) filing with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) - Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: AGM approval within six months after financial year-end; RCS filing within one month after approval, i.e. no later than seven months after the financial year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Formal reminder, daily/lump late penalties in practice; directors may be criminally fined up to EUR 10,000; continued failure after formal notice triggers administrative strike-off (radiation d'office) by the RCS prosecutor.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax and municipal business tax annual returns (déclaration de l'impôt sur le revenu des collectivités et impôt commercial communal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due no later than 31 December of the calendar year following the tax period; extended to 31 March of the second following year for filings made electronically through MyGuichet.lu where automatic extension applies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Default tax assessment, late payment interest at 0.6% per month, administrative fines per the General Tax Law, and enforced collection; no administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Net wealth tax return (déclaration de l'impôt sur la fortune)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same statutory deadline as the corporate income tax return, generally 31 December following the tax period; electronic filing extension may apply.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Default assessment, late interest at 0.6% per month, and administrative penalties; minimum net wealth tax remains due even on dormant SARL balance sheets.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Update and confirmation of beneficial ownership declaration in the Register of Beneficial Owners
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after any share transfer or other change in beneficial ownership; no annual renewal or calendar-year confirmation is separately required, but data must be kept continuously accurate.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or inaccurate filing may result in fines under AML legislation, publication of breach, and, for intentional non-compliance, imprisonment; persistent non-compliance may lead to RCS regulatory removal.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent audit is mandatory if the SARL exceeds more than one of the following criteria on two consecutive balance sheet dates: total assets EUR 4.4 million, net turnover EUR 8.8 million, average headcount 50 employees. Audit also mandatory for public-interest entities, credit/insurance institutions, securitisation vehicles, and companies whose articles require a réviseur d'entreprises agréé.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP (law of 19 December 2002, as amended; EU Accounting Directive transposition) as the statutory framework for individual annual accounts; EU-endorsed IFRS permitted/required for consolidated financial statements of listed groups.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No calendar-year confirmation filing is required under Luxembourg RBE law; however, any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership must be declared within 30 days, and the SARL must keep its RBE entry and its paper register of members continuously aligned. As part of the annual register audit, the directors should verify that each disclosed UBO still holds a qualifying interest and file an amended declaration without delay.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000 - USD 12,000 for a smaller SARL; reduced to USD 0 where the audit exemption applies

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% aggregate statutory headline rate for Luxembourg City (17% corporate income tax + 7% solidarity surcharge on the CIT, i.e. 1.19% + 6.75% municipal business tax); the municipal component varies by commune, producing an aggregate range of approximately 23.7% to 28.6%
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: IP Box: 80% exemption on qualifying net IP income, yielding an effective rate of approximately 4.99%. Participation exemption: 100% exemption for qualifying dividends and capital gains on shareholdings of at least 10% or EUR 1.2 million acquisition cost, held for at least 12 months and subject to tax in the subsidiary. R&D tax credits: up to 25% of qualifying research expenses on first EUR 250,000 and 50% above that threshold in certain cases. Net wealth tax minimum of EUR 535 may still apply even where CIT is reduced to nil.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited carryforward of tax losses under Art. 114 LIR; carryback of losses is not permitted. Anti-abuse: loss carryforward may be denied where a more than 25% change in ownership occurs and the entity is not continued with its original economic activity.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 200 (Déclaration pour l'impôt sur le revenu des collectivités) filed via the eCDF electronic filing portal of the Luxembourg direct tax administration (ACD), accessible through MyGuichet.lu; e-filing is mandatory for corporate entities.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; the same return covers corporate income tax, the solidarity surcharge, and municipal business tax. Quarterly advance payments (impositions anticipées) are due 10 March, 10 June, 10 September, and 10 December.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Paper returns: due 30 June following the fiscal year-end. Electronic returns: generally due 31 December of the calendar year following the fiscal year-end; the ACD annually confirms this automatic extension. For a calendar-year FY ending 31 December 2024, the e-filing deadline is 31 December 2025.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the taxpayer as registered in the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact RCS name; for a non-resident enterprise with a Luxembourg branch, insert the branch style and RCS branch number.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Luxembourg tax identification number (matricule d'identification).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the branch's Luxembourg tax number; the foreign head office taxpayer ID is not sufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the Luxembourg branch address; the foreign registered office is stated only as reference.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable period (begin and end dates of the fiscal year).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a short first period of a newly incorporated branch or SARL, state actual opening and closing dates.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal form and RCS registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State 'Société à responsabilité limitée (SARL)' or 'branch of foreign company', as applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal business activity and NACE code; for this taxpayer use NACE 52.22 / ISIC 5222 (marine claims surveying).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe only the Luxembourg activity of the branch; attach a short explanatory note if surveying is conducted on ships outside Luxembourg territorial waters.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balance sheet: intangible and tangible fixed assets, including survey instruments, vehicles, and leasehold improvements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Record assets economically used by the Luxembourg PE only; assets held abroad are excluded unless assigned to the PE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balance sheet: current assets, including trade receivables from insurers, cash, and work-in-progress on survey assignments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only receivables attributable to the Luxembourg PE's activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Equity: subscribed capital, share premiums, reserves, and retained earnings.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a branch, insert the notional equity allocated to the PE rather than the head office equity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Provisions and deferred taxes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert PE-related provisions only.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Liabilities: trade creditors, loans from shareholders, and accrued expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany payables to the head office must be supported by written agreements and arm's-length interest, if any.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net turnover: gross survey fees invoiced to underwriters, net of invoiced VAT and deductible rebates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Allocate turnover according to where the surveyor's services are effectively rendered; Luxembourg-source services are fully taxable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating profit after direct survey costs, staff costs, travel, and administrative expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductible expenses are those actually borne by the PE; head office general overheads are deductible only on a documented allocation key.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net result before taxes per statutory accounts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile the branch result with the head office books; any discrepancy must be explained.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add-backs (réintégrations): non-deductible expenses, including 50% of business entertainment, fines, and excessive director remuneration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Branch add-backs mirror the head office add-backs allocable to the PE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions: exempt income, including participation-exemption dividends and 80% IP Box deduction.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Not applicable unless the PE holds qualifying participations; attach supporting documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income before loss carryforward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident: aggregate only Luxembourg-source PE income; foreign-source income owned by the head office is excluded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Loss carryforward recognized under Art. 114 LIR.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a loss-history table; losses must be evidenced by prior assessments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income subject to corporate income tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident branch: the same box is used; the PE's net taxable income is calculated on the attribution basis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax at 17%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Standard rate applied to Box 30; no differential rate for non-residents.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Solidarity surcharge: 7% of the corporate income tax (Box 31).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory; no exemption for foreign-owned branches.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Municipal business tax (impôt commercial communal) at the applicable communal rate, e.g. 6.75% for Luxembourg City.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The branch is taxed on the basis of the PE's net taxable income and the commune where the PE is situated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total tax due: sum of Box 31, Box 32, and Box 33.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Total shown is the final liability before crediting advance payments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Advance payments (impositions anticipées) already paid during the year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credit against the final assessment; any balance is refunded or carried forward.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balance due or refundable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any balance due is payable within 30 days of the assessment notice; interest at 0.6% per month accrues on late payment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: coercive administrative fine (Zwangsgeld) of up to EUR 1,000, plus late-payment interest of 0.6% per commenced month on the unpaid tax. Where the return is not filed, the ACD may make an ex officio assessment, applying a 10% surcharge on the assessed tax. Intentional non-filing amounts to tax evasion: fine up to EUR 500,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years.
